Laura Osman / Bloomberg :

 Canada faces intense lobbying from Meta, Apple, Alphabet, and Signal over Bill C-22, which would compel them to retain and hand over metadata to the authorities   —  Prime Minister Mark Carney's government is facing fierce pushback from Big Tech firms over security legislation …
